messages:
jess: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 to backfill auth header parsing in onprem agent. fixes missing tenant header for some legacy proxies. need security eyes for KMS usage + secrets exposure. planning to stage to dedicated-staging Thu.
kai: thanks — pinging sec for KMS review. does this touch key wrap or where key material is loaded? want to be sure we aren't widening key handling surface.
jess: no key material changes. it only reads key id from env and calls existing KMS client. main change in agent/server/auth.go: adds fallback header name and a small normalize step. snippet:
```
// fallback for legacy header
tenant := req.Header.Get("X-Redwood-Tenant")
if tenant == "" {
  tenant = req.Header.Get("X-Tenant-Id")
}
```
security-bot: automated secret-scan: 0 matches in PR #4821 (scan run 2026-03-17T15:02:10Z) :white_check_mark:
arun: also: can you add a short migration note for onprem customers? some proxies rewrite header names — worth documenting workaround and the opt-out.
jess: will add. planning to introduce opt-out env `RW_AGENT_STRICT_HEADERS=true` so customers can preserve strict behavior.
linh: quick ask — can you confirm we don't log tenant ids anywhere in the agent? small grep I ran locally: `kubectl logs -l app=onprem-agent -n redwood | grep -i tenant` — saw only metric labels and health logs. please double-check container log paths.
morgan: holding merge until Friday maintenance window (2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 PT). ops wants grouped onprem changes in one window.
jess: noted — i'll rebase and hold merge. tagging @linh @kai for final sec LGTM and i'll add migration note in the PR description.
linh: scanned diffs + log paths, no secret material printed, left one tiny nit about error string. LGTM from security side :thumbsup:
kai: thanks. i'll add GitHub approval and schedule merge after ops window. will also add a quick rollback step in the PR checklist.
